title: Reality check and a special present: The Digital Services Act turns three.
description: Berlin, October 2, 2025. On October 4, 2025, the Digital Services Act (DSA) will celebrate its third anniversary. Although it is not perfect, AlgorithmWatch considers the DSA to be a landmark of digital regulation. Together with others, the organization has a special gift for the DSA.
